commands.command:
set -eu
ROOT=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
KEY=/Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519
PI=michal@192.168.0.23
MAIN=373d45dbaa7fa18ca7d37f32c75b1808f17bbcd0
TARGET=b590626897118361ad4afd263c8494641a027e0e
test -f "$KEY"
git -C "$ROOT" fetch origin main work/map-loader-hardening-artwork-20261101
test "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse origin/main)" = "$MAIN"
test "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse origin/work/map-loader-hardening-artwork-20261101)" = "$TARGET"
git -C "$ROOT" merge-base --is-ancestor "$MAIN" "$TARGET"
echo ===MAIN_AND_RELEASE_CANDIDATE_VERIFIED===
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$PI" '
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
printf "PI_HEAD="; git rev-parse HEAD
printf "PI_BRANCH="; git branch --show-current
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
systemctl is-active --quiet photomap.service
systemctl is-active --quiet cloudflared.service
printf "BACKEND_PID="; systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID --value
printf "TUNNEL_PID="; systemctl show cloudflared.service -p MainPID --value
printf "PI_INDEX_SHA="; sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk "{print \$1}"
printf "PI_PUBLIC_MAP_ASSET="; grep -o "/assets/public-map-[^\"]*\.js" frontend/dist/index.html | head -1 || true
echo ===RAM_AND_STORAGE===
free -k
df -k .
echo ===DB_CANDIDATES===
find backend/data -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name "*.db" -o -name "*.sqlite" -o -name "*.sqlite3" \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -10 || true
for P in / /health /api/places/map; do
  CODE=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 18 "http://127.0.0.1:8000$P")
  echo "PI_HTTP $P $CODE"
  test "$CODE" = 200
done
echo ===PI_PREFLIGHT_HEALTHY_NO_CHANGES===
'
for P in / /health; do CODE=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 18 "https://photomap.pl$P"); echo "PUBLIC_HTTP $P $CODE"; test "$CODE" = 200; done
echo ===PR65_PREFLIGHT_PASS===
